_deal: The board's test node, until he plays it.
author: jessica, as Ruth Pargeter
source: his 2026-11-02 06:27: "write anotger 3 missions with droppods in them, they are cool"
_note: DROP PODS, 3 of 3. The fight, then the care: clear the pod crews, then treat the three people they hurt. MB87a's triage on the back of a drop, so the fight carries a feeling (the gap in the 11-02 feelings chart: combat closes on 'done').

ELIZA: the three wounded are MB87a's stand-in (placed down at quest start) and the pods land round RECenterLocRef, where the first one lies. Same question as MB95a: are placed friendlies safe from the drop, or does the first wounded move to a marker away from the centre?
Ruth Pargeter's register on the speaker: level, counting, not warm; the care is in the accuracy. Voice borrowed until his ear casts it. No names, places, factions or currency in any voiced line.

place._theme: A quiet site under a pod raid, open sky at the centre.

wounded._wounded: STAND-IN, MB87a's: three settlers placed down and wounded, one at each marker. Eliza's.

prose.name: Rescue: After the Drop at the <Place> on <Planet>
prose.briefing: Raiders are dropping onto the <Place> by pod for the second time this week. Three of its people were hurt in the last drop, and nobody can reach them until the pods are dealt with.
prose.card: Settlement Contract. Clear a drop pod raid at the <Place> on <Planet>, then treat the wounded. Bring med packs. Payment on contract completion.

broadcast: They're dropping on us again, second time this week. Three of ours are still down from the last one. Crews first, please, and then the three.
_speech: Ruth's counts: the second time, the three. No line names how anyone feels.
recap: Pods came down on the <Place>. I cleared the crews and treated the three people they hurt.
recapSay: Three treated, and nobody lost. That's the count I wanted to give.

beats._at: The open middle of the site, for the pods' sky.
beats.objective: Clear the pod crews at the <Place>
beats.journal: I cleared the pod crews at the <Place>. Now I need to see to the three people they hurt.
say: That's the drop dealt with. Three of ours, three med packs. Any order you like.

message.title: Wounded Settler
message.text: A graze from a stray round, high on the shoulder. They count the stitches out loud and lose track at four.

beats.journal: I stitched a graze across one settler's shoulder.

beats.name: Wounded Settler

message.title: Wounded Settler
message.text: Cracked ribs, and every breath is a negotiation. The med pack takes the edge off the next one.

beats.journal: I saw to a settler with cracked ribs. They're breathing easier.

message.text: A sprained ankle from diving clear. They want to know if you saw the pods land. You did.
